Glance 2026.09.24.2 adds font and executable previews and improves window control and layout.

- Preview TrueType, OpenType, font collections, WOFF and WOFF2 with transparent sample text, adjustable size and supported variable weight axes. Font controls stay on one row, and metadata has its own scrolling area. Install supported fonts for the current user or all users through Windows.
- View EXE and DLL summaries with file icons, descriptions, dependencies and resource lists. Open detailed, equal-width tables for imports, exports, PE structure and .NET types, methods and fields; long values wrap within the window. Embedded signer information is displayed when available.
- Keep remembered sizes and positions separate for each preview component, including components that use the same rendering surface.
- Keep preview buttons from taking keyboard focus so Space continues to close the preview.
- Use CLI `--quiet` to suppress stdout; errors use stderr, including with `--json`. Run the CLI from a separate directory when Glance is already running.
- Target the main preview with `--id main`, activate windows with `window activate`, and toggle full-window presentation with `window fullwindow on|off`. Window results identify the main window and report text-loading completeness.
- Let structured JSON previews inherit the window backdrop and refresh update-frequency labels when changing the interface language.
- Release component views when switching files and cancel font rendering without blocking the preview window.
